entries.reason: Accepted: broker.spec.ts:1-3 directly imports the runtime BrokerError class, proving package coupling but not a wire boundary. The final target replaces that fixture with a serializable failure codec and adapter-local constructor, so class identity and cause objects cannot become protocol authority (MAP-654966E128; K02/K03/K07/K11).

Accepted: broker.spec.ts:5-19 preserves an AUTH name/code, permanent flag, and cause identity through BrokerError.from, but it provides no portable policy evidence. The final target keeps that recognition as migration evidence, binds rejection to ProviderSubject and query/dispatch context, and makes category/retryability provider-mapped rather than a universal AUTH rule (MAP-ACEFB58A14; K02/K03/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted after repair: broker.spec.ts:21-28 shows NOT_A_REAL_CODE silently collapsing to UNKNOWN. The final target preserves the redacted raw code and subject, emits UnknownBrokerFailure for an unmapped valid shape, and reserves ProtocolViolation for malformed input, preventing unsafe retry or terminal claims (MAP-1A43E0FCC4; K02/K03/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted: broker.ts:1-12 imports IBKR SDK classes, Decimal, and contract-ext while brokers/types.ts:1-7 re-exports the broad barrel. The final target moves native codecs and exact extensions into provider packs and leaves only schema-derived serializable values at the protocol boundary; replay stores encoded values, not SDK instances (MAP-D4DBF6173C; K01-K04/K07/K11).

Accepted: broker.ts:14-20 exposes a seven-member BrokerErrorCode set that cannot carry route, scope, evidence, or recovery state. The final target uses route/leaf failure schemas with provider extensions and evidence-bound retryability, while retaining legacy labels only as presentation (MAP-6C0ADD0EA4; K02/K03/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted after repair: broker.ts:22-42 combines exception inheritance, a CONFIG/AUTH permanence boolean, and CONNECTING readiness in one code. The final target separates ProviderSubject health/readiness from failure policy and requires evidence-bound retry/account effects, so CONNECTING cannot become a generic failed transaction (MAP-710D1204ED; K02/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted after repair: broker.ts:44-61 and broker.spec.ts:5-28 show structural class recognition plus cause copying and unknown fallback, not a typed boundary decoder. The final target parses unknown at the adapter edge, persists only redacted evidence, and attaches dispatch context through ProviderSubject so public query failures do not acquire an invented account scope (MAP-6ED1656D7F; K02/K03/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted with empirical evidence retained: broker.ts:63-79 only lowercases arbitrary text and applies lexical precedence; it proves neither native fields, idempotency, nor absence. The final target limits KnownNativeFailure to documented adapter mappings and routes heuristic or opaque evidence after possible send to durable Unknown/RecoveryRequired; the retained adapter conformance question remains required (MAP-9F0ED3057E; K02/K07/K08/K11/K12).

Accepted after repair: broker.ts:83-106 makes leverage/liquidation/margin optional and comments that risk may be absent for spot/equity. The final target preserves independent unavailable fields, scopes observations to AccountScope/InstrumentId, and validates units/constraints only for the selected provider leaf, with no implicit leverage default (MAP-F59E470DFF; K02/K03/K04/K08/K11).

Accepted: broker.ts:108-155 mixes native Contract, Decimal quantity, raw currency, monetary strings, and a required multiplier; UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1005-1023 recomputes PnL only for matching currencies. The final PositionObservation keeps scoped refined units, cost-basis and valuation provenance, and makes mixed-currency or legacy multiplier evidence explicit instead of constructing native/default values (MAP-634E72490E; K03/K04/K05/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted after repair: broker.ts:159-168 exposes only a string child orderId and TP/SL kind. The final target adds scoped parent/child identities, provider-defined role/protection extensions, and ProvenAtomic/RuntimeManaged/Unknown group evidence; each leg remains independently observable, so a bare ID cannot imply a linked bracket (MAP-77D0297A77; K02/K04/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted after repair: broker.ts:170-180 uses one success/error/native-state bag for place, modify, and close, allowing contradictory payloads. The final target binds DispatchAcknowledgement and RemoteOutcome to the selected leaf and keeps unknown-after-send, provider rejection, and leg data only where declared, rather than treating a boolean as execution authority (MAP-FE024081BB; K02/K03/K07/K08/K11).

Accepted after repair: broker.ts:184-202 permits partial filters with documented default 60/cap 200, numeric strikes, and no source scope.
